_comment: TonyFlix performance profiles. The wizard applies `common` then the chosen profile (later keys win).
guisettings: Kodi 21.3 setting ids (checked against system/settings/settings.xml + android.xml + option fillers).
Applied with JSON-RPC Settings.SetSettingValue from inside Kodi; ids missing on a platform are skipped.
advancedsettings: written to userdata/advancedsettings.xml (needs a restart). Kodi 21 moved the video cache to
GUI settings (filecache.*), so <cache> is NOT used here.
addons: add-on settings, applied one at a time (parallel setSetting calls clobber each other).
skin: Skin.SetBool / Skin.Reset / Skin.SetString on skin.tonyflix.

detection._comment: Wizard suggests Lite if ANY rule matches; the user can always pick the other profile. RAM cutoff is 2.5 GB because weak boxes are already caught by GPU/chip rules (and cheap boxes often misreport RAM).
detection._gpu_note: GPU from Kodi's System.VideoEncoderInfo ('GPU: Mali-T720'); chip from /proc/cpuinfo Hardware. T95 Max (Allwinner H6 = sun50iw6, Mali-T720) and T95 Max+ (Amlogic S905X3 = sm1, Mali-G31) both land on Lite.

lite._why: Weak GPU / little RAM: render the GUI at 720p, small artwork, fewer rows, no constant redraws.

standard._why: 4 GB+ boxes with a decent GPU: 1080p GUI, medium artwork (w1280 backdrops instead of 4K originals), full rows.
